name: Fixed-Budget Optimisation
definition: An optimisation approach where the user specifies a maximum budget, and the optimisation is constrained not to surpass that value. A fractional assignment of cost to each panel is learnt.
summary: Fixed-Budget Optimisation is a constraint-aware training strategy that learns fractional cost assignments to ensure the final model size matches a user-specified maximum budget exactly, without requiring balancing coefficients in the loss function.
